query: Players report that with an Xbox pad the car slowly steers left when the stick is released, and full stick deflection never quite reaches full lock on a worn controller. Please investigate how the gamepad dead zone, saturation and per-pad centre calibration are computed in js/input/input.js, and fix the drift without adding lag.
phone tilt steering feels twitchy and the calibrate-centre thing doesnt seem 2 stick after i rotate the phone to portrait. can u figure out whats up w tilt sens / MAX_TILT and make it behave

When I'm in the pause menu and hit the arrow keys, the car underneath still steers and after I resume it keeps turning for a moment. Keys seem to leak from the keyboard handler into the game. Find out why and stop it.

The steering feel presets (SUPER EASY, ASSISTED, NORMAL, SIM) in js/input/steer-tuning.js: I want to add a slider tweak so touch steering uses a smaller fraction of the screen edge for full lock, and make sure the migration of old saved slider values still works. Walk me through the change and the specs to run.

On mobile, the on-screen left/right steer buttons stay 'held' if I slide my thumb off them and lift it, so the car keeps turning until I tap again. Also the racing-line driving help sometimes stays highlighted. Diagnose the touch-release handling.

The car understeers badly in slow hairpins at Monaco even with keyboard steering; turn-in should be snappier. Compare grip settings with an A/B run through the headless obs/act loop and tell me whether the driving feel improved.

Pressing Escape while the gamepad settings dialog is open closes the whole menu instead of just the dialog, and keyboard focus is lost afterwards. Fix the back behaviour and focus return for the controls screen.

I want to capture before/after screenshots of the cockpit camera while steering into Eau Rouge with full lock, and check the camera lag looks right when the wheel is turned quickly. Batch them headless.
